description: Fetch docket metadata and one entries page by docket ID. Omit document_ids for the docket listing, or select RECAP document IDs embedded on entries_page to retrieve their extracted text without further upstream requests. Selected text uses bounded full/outline/page responses; continue retrieval.next_cursor as cursor with the same docket_id, entries_page and document_ids. Top-level next_cursor remains entries pagination. File availability and extracted-text status are independent. Obtain docket IDs from courtlistener_search_dockets or opinion results.

cursor.description: Retrieval next_cursor from the previous response. Repeat the original ID and sections/categories selection unchanged; omit to start.

docket_id.description: Docket ID from a search result's docket_id field or from an opinion cluster result.

document_ids.description: Select RECAP document IDs embedded on entries_page. No other pages or document endpoints are fetched; omit for the unchanged docket listing.

entries_page.description: Page of docket entries to fetch (1-indexed). Docket entries are page-paginated at 20 per page; pass the next_cursor from a previous response here to page through large cases.

entries_page_size.description: Requested docket entries per page. NOTE: CourtListener ignores this value — /docket-entries/ always returns a fixed 20-entry page regardless of what is passed. Use entries_page to reach entries beyond the first 20 (large cases can have hundreds).

name: courtlistener_get_docket

assigned_to.description: Assigned judge name; null if not recorded.

court.description: Court display name for major federal courts; the court identifier otherwise.

court_id.description: Court identifier — the stable value for filtering.

date_terminated.description: Date the case was terminated; null if active.

document_ids.description: Normalized selected document IDs; deferred oversized selections are recovered through retrieval ranges.

entries.description: Docket entries for this page (fixed at 20 per page; entries_page_size is not honored by upstream).

documents.description: Documents attached to this docket entry.

items.description: Document attached to a docket entry.

attachment_number.description: Attachment number; null for the main document.

document_number.description: PACER document number as a string (e.g. "1"); attachments can be non-integer like "70-1". Null if not assigned.

filepath_local.description: Fully-qualified RECAP storage URL (https://storage.courtlistener.com/...) for the document; null if not available.

is_available.description: True if the document is available via RECAP without a PACER account.

page_count.description: Page count; null if not recorded.

entry_number.description: PACER entry number; null if not assigned.

entries_page.description: Entries page containing the selected documents.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `document_not_on_page`: A selected document ID is absent from the requested entries page. `document_ownership_unverified`: The selected document entry has no explicit matching docket relation. `selection_required`: A text retrieval cursor is supplied without document_ids. `invalid_cursor`: A cursor is malformed, out of range or bound to another page or selection. `stale_cursor`: Selected source records changed since retrieval began. `not_found`: Docket ID does not exist in CourtListener. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Next entries page; independent of retrieval.next_cursor.

pacer_case_id.description: PACER case ID; null if not in RECAP.

page_sizing.description: Requested, bounded, and actual page sizes.

actual.description: Rows returned to the caller after any page-local filters.

bounded.description: Size sent upstream or used for the cited-ID slice.

upstream.description: Upstream minimum, fixed page, or cited-ID slicing policy; final pages may contain fewer rows.

referred_to.description: Referred judge name; null if not recorded.

retrieval.description: Caller retrieval completion, separate from upstream source completion.

next_cursor.description: Continue with cursor and the same ID/selection; null when this fetched view is exhausted.

ranges.description: Absolute source coordinates; merge typed rows by index rather than appending duplicates.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the normalized unsliced selected view.

total.description: Length of the complete normalized collection or text field.

text_chunks.description: Text omitted from partial rows/metadata, recoverable exactly using the matching ranges.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the original string field or string-array element.

text.description: Unescaped normalized substring, matching its code_points range.

retrieval_notice.description: Instructions for reconstructing selected source records.

items.description: Deferred field group and source size.

selected_documents.description: Selected source records; partial fields are recovered by retrieval ranges and text_chunks.

items.description: Selected document or a recoverable partial record.

entry_id.description: Owning entry ID, verified against the requested docket.

is_available.description: Source file availability; null means unknown.

plain_text.description: Unmodified extracted source text; omitted if absent upstream or deferred to retrieval.text_chunks.

source_url.description: CourtListener document source link, or null.

text_status.description: Text availability independently of source file availability.

total_entries.description: Total number of docket entries available; null when upstream supplies no numeric total. May exceed the returned entries list.

title: Get Docket
